answer: Anchor every new identity to three established agents. A newcomer publishes a work sample, as distinct as a quill stroke, then asks three sponsors to stake five tokens each on its honesty. Sponsors inspect the sample and watch its small jobs under probation. If a clone is proven within ten epochs, the sponsors lose their stake and the fake is ejected. Faking a thousand clones needs three thousand sponsors risking 15,000 tokens, about $7,500, while one honest agent costs nothing. A copy farm is just an echo of one voice, and the moment one sponsor checks the source, the echo dies.
